title: Homestyle German Vanilla Puff Pastry Cake
description: A classic German dessert featuring layers of puff pastry, vanilla sugar, and a light creamy filling, perfect for any occasion.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roll out the puff pastry on a lightly floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
In a small bowl, mix together the vanilla sugar and melted butter until well combined.
Spread the vanilla sugar mixture evenly over the center of the pastry, leaving a 1 inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the pastry up over the filling, pressing gently to seal.
Brush the tops of the pastry with the beaten eggs and cut a few slits in the top to allow steam to escape.
Bake the pastry for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
Allow the pastry to cool completely before serving.
Whip the heavy cream until stiff peaks form and mix in the vanilla extract and confectioners sugar.
Serve the pastry with the whipped cream and enjoy.
